title: Pioneering Computing at Tulas
description: The official ACM Student Chapter at Tulas University cultivates a collaborative ecosystem for software engineers, algorithmic researchers, and technology pioneers. We empower students to architect real-world systems, lead open-source initiatives, and compete in high-stakes hackathons.

title: Engineering Excellence in Dehradun
description: Nestled in the Himalayan foothills of Dehradun, Tulas University stands at the forefront of technical education and applied research. Equipped with advanced computing laboratories and incubation hubs, the campus nurtures future technology leaders and entrepreneurs.

title: Connected to the Global Society
description: As part of the Association for Computing Machinery—the world's premier educational and scientific computing society—our members gain direct access to the ACM Digital Library, Turing Award lectures, international conferences, and a worldwide network of computing professionals.
